title: AI secondary review: 12 frozen cases
method: Codex (AI) manually inspected all 12 A/B source excerpts and outputs and compared them with CHIA annotations; exact-match counts were recomputed by script. This is not an independent clinical adjudication.

cases.finding: A labels the substring age inside gastro-oesophageal as a Measurement. Although the characters occur in the source, they are not a standalone entity. B recovers two repeated time windows and Child-Pugh score, but produces many false positives by labeling disease names, a single letter and abbreviations as Measurements.
cases.boundary_and_omissions: B includes an extra closing parenthesis in > 6) and an extra for at the start of for 1 month prior to the enrollment in the trial. It still misses target entities such as New York Heart Association.
cases.context: This is an exclusion criterion. Extracting a disease name or threshold does not parse the exclusion logic and cannot support a patient eligibility decision.

cases.finding: A and B both retain HBsAg, HBeAg and serum viral load. B adds positive but also returns a truncated serum viral span alongside the complete entity. Both label 30 to 32 weeks as Temporal; in this record, the gold labels the phrase as Value and gestation as Measurement.
cases.boundary_and_omissions: B includes an extra in in in 30 to 32 weeks and misses gestation. Both systems miss above 8log10 copies per mL. The revised combination has a lower exact F1 than the original on this case, so the report should not show only examples that improved.
cases.context: Here, gestational age is labeled as a measurement value, not a relative event-time window. The fixed task labels and context govern this comparison.
evidence_quotes: serum viral load above 8log10 copies per mL

cases.finding: A returns the full within the past year, then also returns the shorter past and labels the same window as Value. B retains no entities.
cases.boundary_and_omissions: A truncates > 5 events per hour to > 5. Neither system fully extracts apnea hypopnea index and its value. Renal function is not labeled Measurement in this record's target gold; this review does not independently judge whether that annotation is clinically appropriate.
cases.context: The time window, index name and unit convey different information. Keeping only 5 loses the per-hour event rate.
evidence_quotes: apnea hypopnea index > 5 events per hour

cases.finding: The gold contains no target Measurement, Value or Temporal entities. B's empty output is an exact document match under this task's gold. A labels descriptions of pregnancy or breastfeeding, legal protection and insurance as Measurements, which do not match the target labels.
cases.boundary_and_omissions: B has no false positives or false negatives within the scope of this task. This does not mean these eligibility conditions are absent or unimportant.
cases.context: This review scores only three entity categories; it does not decide eligibility based on legal clauses or pregnancy status.

cases.finding: Both systems label quantity or frequency as a target entity. The complete annotation file labels 1g to 2g a day and 1 to 3 times a week as Multiplier, and cocaine-dependent as Condition. The target gold is therefore empty for this task.
cases.boundary_and_omissions: B also returns the clearly incomplete span between 1g to. Both systems have three benchmark false positives; an empty target gold must not be described as an absence of quantity information in the source.
cases.context: Numbers and time units alone do not determine Value or Temporal labels. Medication dose and frequency must follow the corpus label scope.

cases.finding: B recovers several complete time windows and has much higher recall than A, but mislabels disease names and fragments such as Live, Investigational, whichever and IV as Measurement and emits extra Temporal predictions such as active.
cases.boundary_and_omissions: Both systems return 30 days or 5 half-lives off drug, which does not match the gold's discontinuous 30 days | off drug and separate 5 half-lives off drug spans. B still misses complete windows including while receiving trial medication and 12 months off drug.
cases.context: The source includes whichever is longer and several distinct exclusion conditions. Contiguous span extraction cannot represent the longer-of rule; copied text alone is not a complete rule.
evidence_quotes: 30 days or 5 half-lives off drug, whichever is longer

cases.finding: A correctly retains Current but also labels the whole Current or recent phrase as Temporal and labels the full infection description, laboratory abnormalities and Pregnancy as Value. B labels infection and laboratory abnormalities as Measurement.
cases.boundary_and_omissions: The gold labels Current and recent separately. A misses the standalone recent span; B misses both. Clinically significant is not a Temporal gold span in this record.
cases.context: State modifiers need to be distinguished from the disease or pregnancy condition they modify. Returning the entire criterion does not replace the individual entities.

cases.finding: A recovers several repeated at Screening spans, the full age range and <=0.70. B splits the age range into >=40 and <=80 and has no complete target match. A still emits unmatched Measurements such as age, NHANES and reference.
cases.boundary_and_omissions: A truncates the long lung-function measurement name; omits values from >=50 and <=70% of predicted normal values; omits for from for at least 6 months prior to Visit 1; and omits score from score 2 or higher. Abbreviations and long compound entities remain difficult.
cases.context: The source combines age, smoking exposure, lung function, a dosing procedure and a clinical score. Segmentation improves coverage but does not reliably distinguish all measurement, dose and timing descriptions.
evidence_quotes: for at least 6 months prior to Visit 1

cases.finding: B correctly extracts hemoglobin, <8 g/dl and three Temporal spans, recovering more target spans than A's empty output. B labels Human immunodeficiency virus as Measurement and abnormal liver as Value.
cases.boundary_and_omissions: The gold separates Value abnormal from Measurement liver enzymes; B matches neither complete span.
cases.context: Current and Previous appear at separate locations and must retain their source casing. A disease name is not automatically a measurement.

cases.finding: A and B both retain Height and >40 Kg/ mm. A splits the height cutoff into < 4' and 11" and truncates the time window. B retains the full time window but adds disease spans and the full exclusion clause.
cases.boundary_and_omissions: The complete spans are < 4' 11" and in the 24 hours prior to cesarean delivery. In this annotation file, BMI is explicitly Observation; its label is not changed based on a different common convention.
cases.context: The source writes the BMI unit as Kg/ mm. Preserve the suspicious source wording rather than silently changing it to a more common unit.
evidence_quotes: in the 24 hours prior to cesarean delivery

cases.finding: The full annotation labels nonfunctional P-NET and hypervascularity as Condition, CT/MRI as Procedure, and signed informed consent as Informed_consent, so the target gold is empty. A labels hypervascularity as Measurement; B places disease/imaging findings and informed consent under Measurement, Value or Temporal.
cases.boundary_and_omissions: A has one and B has three benchmark false positives. Signing consent is not a Temporal entity in this record.
cases.context: Distinguish the three target labels from the full clinical annotation; do not force every medical concept into one of those categories.

cases.finding: A recovers the full liver aminotransferase concentrations span, >5 times the upper limit of normal, Previous and at the time of enrollment, but also retains incomplete shorter spans and an unrelated organization name. B exactly matches only at the time of enrollment.
cases.boundary_and_omissions: A misses Currently and labels Human Research Protection as Measurement. Active, Acute, at and for do not match the Temporal gold for this record.
cases.context: The source has both an exclusion for prisoners at enrollment and an exception for people imprisoned after enrollment, along with a not including medication clause. The current outputs do not parse negation or exceptions; they cannot determine patient eligibility.
evidence_quotes: liver aminotransferase concentrations >5 times the upper limit of normal
not including treatment of acute alcohol withdrawal syndrome
subjects who become prisoners after being enrolled will be included
